subject: OrbitAI — Vector harmonization & rerank acceptance playbook

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Subject: OrbitAI handoff — vector harmonization scope + initial cost estimate

Evelyn,

Quick handoff from the AE side — OrbitAI (Priya/PJ and Alex) has committed to a dedicated rollout for Q3. They want a predictable rerank pipeline and a single index across two product lines (search + recommendations). Highlights from discovery: 

- ~20M rows to seed; they expect 10–15k daily updates (new items + metadata edits).
- Primary model: 3B open model (we discussed psuedo-quantized variant).
- Reranker will be a lightweight pointwise model layered on top of candidate retrieval; customer wants an acceptance gate with PR-AUC and manual sample review.
- Major constraint: OrbitAI is on a strict data retention policy (90 days hot, archive thereafter) and uses GCP us-central region.

I attached an index backfill estimate (orbit_index_backfill_estimate.xlsx) and a quick sampling of rerank cases (rerank_eval_samples.csv).

Asks for you: 
1) Draft a one-page playbook for the handoff that includes an acceptance checklist (smoke tests, ranking regressions, perf SLOs).
2) Call out vectorstore tradeoffs — they mentioned both managed vector DB and self-hosted Postgres+pgvector as possibilities.
3) Recommend a staged backfill cadence (we talked about a 3-wave approach with pilot ~1% sample).

I suggest an intro call with Alex + Priya this afternoon if you can — they want to finalize timing by EOD. I can join if helpful.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole

Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OrbitAI — Vector harmonization & rerank acceptance playbook

Hi Alex / Priya — thanks for the time earlier. Intro + proposed plan below.

Short intro: I’m Evelyn (CSM, Implementation) — I’ll own the onboarding cadence, acceptance testing, and the roll to production. Jordan (solutions) will lead ingestion/DB decisions; Ben (eng ops) will size dedicated serving pools and run the smoke tests with us. Marissa will stay on as AE.

High-level handoff playbook (proposed) — see attached onboarding timeline (onboard_timeline.v1.pdf):

1) Pilot wave (2 weeks) — sample sync of ~1% of catalog (~200k vectors) into a staging vectorstore; run rerank evals on 1k labeled queries from the samples; measure delta vs baseline (current prod). Smoke tests: query latency P95 < 120ms; top-10 PR-AUC not worse than -2 points.

2) Incremental backfill (3 waves across 4 weeks) — each wave grows the seeded index 5x; monitor op-queue lag and tail latency; verify cold-start recall on archive slices.

3) Cutover & fallback policy — pin rollout with canary routing (10% traffic) and rollback trigger on ranking drift > 3 PR-AUC points or latency regression >20% above SLO.

Vectorstore tradeoffs — quick take: 
- Managed vector DB (hosted): easier scaling and ops, faster backfill with parallel bulk loaders, but watch for egress and retention config complexity.
- Self-hosted pgvector (Postgres): strong retention control and simpler audit logs but higher write/maintenance overhead and larger storage costs for 20M rows.

Immediate asks from OrbitAI: 
A) Confirm which vectorstore option you prefer for staging (managed vs pgvector).
B) Share two sample CSV exports for low/high item frequency so Jordan can size shard strategy.
C) Confirm a 60–90 minute kickoff tomorrow (Fri) 10–11am PT or 2–3pm PT.

Next steps I’ll take: prepare the acceptance checklist (inc. rerank eval script, sample size, perf gates), schedule the kickoff, and create a shared Drive folder for artifacts.

If that plan looks OK I’ll lock the kickoff and route the Drive link + prep doc.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwood.com

Attachment: onboard_timeline.v1.pdf (pdf, 120KB)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@orbitai.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Malhotra <priya@orbitai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OrbitAI — Vector harmonization & rerank acceptance playbook

Evelyn — thanks, plan looks sensible. Couple of clarifications from our side before kickoff: 

1) Retention: we can provide hot 90-day CSVs and a separate monthly archive snapshot. Archive access is required for offline evaluation but should not be in active serving. Does Redwood support a two-tier retrieval flow (hot first, archive if miss)?

2) Vectorstore: leaning toward managed for the pilot to move faster, but we need clear controls on retention TTLs and an SLA for deletion. Can Jordan/Solutions outline deletion verification steps?

3) API keys: we’ll generate a read-only staging key and a ingest key scoped to a single service account. Expect those after the kickoff.

We are good for the 10–11am PT slot tomorrow. Please send a calendar invite + link to the Drive folder.

—Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Search, OrbitAI
alex.johnson@orbitai.com

Thanks Alex — locking the 10–11am PT kickoff and sending the invite now. Calendar invite includes a Zoom link and the Drive folder: https://drive.example.com/drive/folders/OrbitAI-Onboard

Quick answers to your questions: 
- Two-tier retrieval: yes — Redwood supports hot-first then archive fallback. We will not include archive docs in the serving vectorstore for live traffic; archive is available for offline eval and rehydration. Jordan will document the verification steps we’ll run after each backfill wave to confirm deletion/TTL enforcement.
- Deletion verification: we’ll run hash-based spot checks and retention-list audits against the vectorstore snapshot; Ben will add a smoke test that verifies a stale ID is purged end-to-end.
- API keys: please upload the staging keys to the Drive folder or paste them in the secure HubSpot secret field; avoid pasting in email.

I’ve attached the initial acceptance checklist in the Drive folder and dropped the rerank_eval_samples.csv under /samples. Agenda for tomorrow: 
1) Kickoff + roles (10m)
2) Ingestion plan & vectorstore decision (20m)
3) Backfill cadence & sampling (15m)
4) Rerank acceptance criteria + eval plan (10m)
5) Next steps & owner assignments (5m)

If you have any pre-kickoff artifacts (sample CSVs, schema, retention policy) please upload them to the Drive folder before 9am PT tomorrow so Jordan can review.

See you tomorrow —
Evelyn
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
evelyn_hart@redwood.com
